notes.title: Small UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone here are a couple of things I changed, fixed.

* I added a costume to celebrate the mexican game festival
* I changed the graphics of the humans to be in line with the next game HTMN
* some minor inventory additions!

notes.title: Bug fixes and graphics changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone I fixeda couple of minor bugs and some graphical changes

* A problem in the intro screen
* The humans now appear more evil, they looked to friendly and clean before
* Some small graphic changes for Boney
* A problem reading books

notes.title: Small bug fix!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone I fixeda couple of minor bugs.

* quiting in the first stage no longer takes you to the 2nd level
* the dooter now works when used subsequently
* removed the sticking to walls , replaced  with the crawling
* removed some places where you can get stuck

notes.title: Small bug fix!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone I fixeda couple of minor bugs.

* the UI not appearing  on level 3

notes.title: Small bug fix 2!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone I worked on a couple of things.

* the bone throw now spawns bones that are more easily detectable 
* The trash doesn't get destroyed by snapping pictures or the dooter
* You can no longer destroy the pumpkings, thankfully poor pumpkins
